author: independent_review
limits: RSS entries are sampled values, not true peaks or a strict kernel cap.
New isolated diagnostics cannot establish the unrecorded original broad-run cause.
Acceptance is not a passing test or a fix for the memory-cap miss.
scope: Static pre-use review only. Exact original noisy-output and memory-limit tests; execute serially after current coordinator closes.
verified: Original request, caps, timeouts, test assertions and returned objects preserved.
Observes only existing supervisor code-line events and local values; no extra process poll or RSS query.
Collected test alias and original module binding both restored in finally.
Tracer only installed when absent and removed in finally; no subprocess tracer injection.
Actual request/result, supervisor events and source/input before/finally pins retained.
